SELECT p.id, p.discogs_release_id FROM product p
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count, MAX(viewed_at) AS last_viewed_at FROM product_view_log WHERE viewed_at >= #{viewSince} GROUP BY product_id ) v ON v.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.discogs_release_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.discogs_synced_at IS NULL OR p.discogs_synced_at < #{staleBefore}) AND p.status <> 'HIDDEN' ORDER BY
v.view_count DESC, v.last_viewed_at DESC, p.discogs_synced_at ASC, p.id ASC p.discogs_synced_at ASC, p.id ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.discogs_release_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.discogs_synced_at IS NULL OR p.discogs_synced_at < #{staleBefore})
